review_method: Rendered all prepared images in labeled contact sheets and visually reviewed every sheet at thumbnail scale.
class_content_match: The visible contents generally match the cardboard, glass, metal, paper, and plastic labels. No obvious unrelated image or class-level mismatch was noticed.

visual_findings.people: No clearly identifiable bystander was apparent in the contact sheets. One item appears to contain a printed portrait on packaging; this is a depiction on a product, not evidence of a photographed bystander.
visual_findings.brands_and_text: Product branding and package text are visible in many images. This visual observation is not a trademark or rights clearance.
visual_findings.backgrounds: Images show discarded items on indoor floors, pavement, soil, and other everyday surfaces. No location was inferred from those backgrounds.
visual_findings.review_limit: This was a thumbnail-scale visual screen for image content and obvious privacy issues, not a full-resolution forensic privacy review or legal assessment.

metadata_handling: The reviewed prepared artifact has EXIF/GPS/TIFF metadata removed according to the existing preparation audit. This does not establish that all visual privacy concerns are absent.

rights_review.source_license_claim: CC BY 4.0, as recorded in the source audit
rights_review.status: redistribution and rights review remain pending

release_decision: Keep public release and library availability on hold pending rights review. The visual review does not change that hold.
